pairings.nmcName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal
pairings.evidence: Same institution, acronym vs expansion. NMC row city Bhopal, affiliation 'Statutory Autonomous, AIIMS(Bhopal)', website aiimsbhopal.edu.in. Not paired with Gandhi Medical College, Bhopal (a separate Bhopal college that keeps its own NMC row).

pairings.ourName: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Government Medical College, Vidisha
pairings.evidence: GMC Vidisha's official name is Atal Bihari Vajpayee Government Medical College. NMC address 'Sagar Road, NH-86, In front of Govt. Khel Parisar, Vidisha - 454001'; website gmcvidisha.org. Only one government medical college exists in Vidisha.

pairings.ourName: Chhindwara Institute of Medical Sciences, Chhindwara
pairings.evidence: CIMS Chhindwara is the government medical college of Chhindwara. NMC address 'Govt. Medical College, Mandhata, Shivam Sundram Colony ... Chhindwara - 480001'; website govtmedicalcollegechhindwara.com. Only one government medical college in Chhindwara.

NMC address 'Govt. Medical College, Near 29 Batallion, NH-75, Distt. Datia- 475661 (M.P.)' and website datiamedicalcollege.com both confirm Datia. NOTE: this NMC row's city FIELD wrongly reads 'Ratlam' (bad data in the registry) — city taken from the row's own address instead. Government Medical College, Ratlam is a separate NMC row with its own Ratlam address (Gram Banjali, Sailana Road) and 180 seats; the two are different colleges and were not conflated.

pairings.ourName: Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Medical College, Indore
pairings.nmcName: M G M Medical College, Indore
pairings.evidence: M.G.M. = Mahatma Gandhi Memorial; same Indore government college, established 1948, 250 seats. Not paired with any Indore dental college (see rule 3).

pairings.ourName: Nandkumar Singh Chouhan Government Medical College, Khandwa
pairings.evidence: GMC Khandwa was renamed after Nandkumar Singh Chouhan. NMC address 'Luvkush Nagar Mundi Road, Tehsil Khandwa, District. Khandwa - 450001'; website gmckhandwa.org. Only one government medical college in Khandwa.

pairings.nmcName: Ruxmaniben Deepchand Gardi Medical College, Ujjain
pairings.evidence: R.D. = Ruxmaniben Deepchand. Same Ujjain private college, affiliated to Vikram University, Ujjain; website rdgmc.edu.in.

pairings.ourName: RKDF Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Bhopal
pairings.nmcName: RKDF Medical College Hospital & Research Centre, Jatkhedi, Bhopal
pairings.evidence: Same college; Jatkhedi is the Bhopal locality of the campus. Website rkdfmedicalcollege.org. Distinct from 'Ram Krishna College Hospital & Research Centre, Bhopal', which retains its own NMC row.

pairings.ourName: Shrimant Rajmata Vijayaraje Scindia Medical College, Shivpuri
pairings.evidence: GMC Shivpuri's official name is Shrimant Rajmata Vijayaraje Scindia Medical College. NMC address 'Govt. Medical College, Main Gwalior Highway, Near Katha Mill, Shivpuri-473551 (M.P.)'; website shivpurimedicalcollege.com. Only one government medical college in Shivpuri.

enrichment.name: Government College of Dentistry, Indore
enrichment.source: BDS college — not in the NMC registry, which is MBBS-only. Official site https://www.gdcindore.com/ : 'Government Autonomous College of Dentistry, Indore (M.P.)', 'The College of Dentistry, Indore a maiden and Government Dental Institute of Madhya Pradesh was started in 1961', teaching '63 undergraduate students ... admitted every year'. Seats corroborated by the MP DME NEET-UG 2025 seat chart, row '18- Government Dental College Indore  63' — https://www.dme.mponline.gov.in/ql_dme/DMECounselling_Public/DMEUG/2025/Seat%20chart%20MBBS%20BDS%202025_18.pdf . Affiliation dropped: the official site never states an affiliating university (it only lists MPMSU Jabalpur under 'Important Links'), so the claim was unsourced. NOT the same institution as M G M Medical College, Indore (MBBS), which is a separate college.
